pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: iwl7000: Merge core35 driver updates This is a merge commit of all Intel patches for the core35 driver update since commit ab1e00f3021571afe34e4d5574679dd984a4dc19 and ending at commit 2d7fe03329806e44b5ae4dadce6c26393a9451d8. Core31 update to the iwl7000 driver pulled in an iwl7000-specific implementation of cfg80211, iwl7000_cfg80211.ko, which provides the same functionality as cfg80211.ko and cannot co-exist with it. cfg80211.ko was disabled on Intel systems. arc: network: Make sure arc0 is down before netd starts Bringing up veth_android implicitly brings up slave_android (arc0), too. arc-networkd polls the IFF_UP status of arc0 to figure out when netd starts, so if arc0 is already up when it is transferred into the container, that can cause bad assumptions which lead to an arc-networkd crash. So, force arc0 down initially to prevent that from happening.
